EMPLOYEES.TITLE: Employees
EMPLOYEES.SUBTITLE: Manage your team members, their access and permissions

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.FULL_SYSTEM_ACCESS: Full access to all branches and settings
FORM.PRIMARY_HINT: Click the ⭐ next to a branch to mark it as the employee's primary branch. The primary branch is used by attendance reports.
FORM.TERMINATION_HINT: Leave empty if the employee is currently employed.
FORM.PASSWORD_MIN: Password must be at least 8 characters
FORM.PASSCODE_IN_USE: This pass code is already being used
FORM.EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS: This email is already registered as an employee
FORM.EMAIL_EXISTS: This email already belongs to an InvoCloud user.
FORM.KEEP_EMPTY_PASSWORD: Keep it empty to not change the password
FORM.KEEP_EMPTY_PASSCODE: Keep it empty to not change the pass code
FORM.KEEP_EMPTY_MSR: Keep it empty to not change the MSR
FORM.PASSCODE_MIN: Passcode must be at least 4 digits
FORM.UNSAVED_LEAVE_HINT: You have unsaved changes on this profile form. Opening another tab (Documents, Payroll, Leave…) leaves this form and discards them. Leave without saving?
FORM.UNSAVED_TABS_NOTE: Unsaved changes — save before opening another tab above.
FORM.SYSTEM_ACCESS_HINT: This employee signs in to the portal or the POS.
FORM.SYSTEM_ACCESS_OFF_HINT: No login. The record still holds attendance and HR details.
FORM.CREDENTIALS_RETIRED_HINT: The previous pass code and swipe id are retired on restoring access — enter new ones. Access was ended by removing this employee's roles, not by deleting the credential, which is shared with any other company they work for.
FORM.EDUCATION_CERTIFICATE_HINT: To attach a certificate, add it under Documents with the type "Qualification" — documents also track expiry and verification.
FORM.SALES_PERSON_ROLE: Can be chosen as the salesperson on invoices

TOUR.NOTHING_TO_SHOW: There's nothing to walk through on this screen yet.

INTRO.TITLE: 👋 The Employee Record
INTRO.BODY: A quick walkthrough of the section you're on. Switch to another section and take the tour again to see it. Use the buttons or ← / → to move, and Esc to leave at any point.

SYSTEM_ACCESS.TITLE: System access
SYSTEM_ACCESS.BODY: Turn this off for someone who works here but never signs in — a warehouse or kitchen worker. They still get a record, attendance and HR details; they just get no credentials, no roles and no privilege set.

BASIC.TITLE: Basic information
BASIC.BODY: The employee's name, plus the credentials for however they sign in. Which credential fields appear depends on the roles you pick in the next step.

EMAIL.TITLE: Email
EMAIL.BODY: The address a Cloud Admin signs in with. It's checked as you type: if it already belongs to an InvoCloud user, you'll be offered the invitation flow instead.

PASSWORD.TITLE: Password
PASSWORD.BODY: At least 8 characters. When editing someone later, leave this alone to keep their current password — you only fill it in to change it.

ROLES.TITLE: Employee roles
ROLES.BODY: Cloud Admin signs in to this portal with an email and password. POS User signs in at the till with a pass code. Driver is an extra flag for deliveries, not a sign-in method. At least one sign-in role stays selected.

ACCESS.TITLE: Access & permissions
ACCESS.BODY: The privilege set decides what this person can see and do. The MSR field holds a swipe-card id, if your tills use them.

IMAGE.TITLE: Photo
IMAGE.BODY: Pick a photo from the media library. It shows on the employee list and at the till.

BRANCHES.TITLE: Branch assignment
BRANCHES.BODY: Every branch this person works at. Use Add Branch to assign more, and the × to remove one. One is the primary branch, marked with a star — that's the one their till prices and services are pulled from.

PRIMARY_STAR.TITLE: The primary branch
PRIMARY_STAR.BODY: Click a star to make that branch primary. Only one can be, and it matters: the till uses the primary branch to decide which prices and services this employee gets.

EMPLOYMENT.TITLE: Employment
EMPLOYMENT.BODY: Hire date, and a termination date once someone leaves. Leaving the termination date empty means they're still employed.

HR_PROFILE.TITLE: Personal details
HR_PROFILE.BODY: The person behind the account: contact details, nationality, address, emergency contacts and dependants. Required fields are marked; the rest can be filled in over time.

HR_EMPLOYMENT.TITLE: Employment details
HR_EMPLOYMENT.BODY: Department, position, manager and contract terms. Department and position offer the values already used elsewhere in your company — pick one, or type a new one.

STEPPER.TITLE: Four steps
STEPPER.BODY: Each step saves before moving on, so you can stop after any of them and come back later. Completed steps stay clickable.

PAYMENT.TITLE: How they get paid
PAYMENT.BODY: Bank transfer asks for the account. Cash and cheque need nothing further, so the fields disappear.

HEADER.TITLE: Employee Header
HEADER.BODY: Who this record belongs to: name, status, email, branch and roles. It stays put on every tab, so you always know whose record you're in. The ⋯ button holds actions such as Start Offboarding.

RECORD_TABS.TITLE: Record Tabs
RECORD_TABS.BODY: Each tab is a different part of the employee: documents, assets, leave, performance, disciplinary, payroll and end of service. A number is how many records are on file; an amber dot means setup is still needed.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Profile Sections
SECTIONS.BODY: The profile is split into Basic, Personal, Employment and Payment details. One Save at the bottom saves them all, and any section with an error shows a red count.

PROFILE.NAME_AR_HINT: Used on official documents and payroll files.
PROFILE.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER_HINT: HR's own number for this employee — not the POS pass code.
PROFILE.PERSONAL_EMAIL_HINT: Kept after the work email is closed.
PROFILE.HOME_ADDRESS_HINT: Address in the employee's home country (shown when nationality differs from the country of residence).
PROFILE.DEPENDENTS_HINT: Used later for insurance and family visas.

EMPLOYMENT.SENIORITY_DATE_HINT: Defaults to the hire date; differs on a rehire or a transfer.
EMPLOYMENT.LOOKUP_HINT: Pick a value already in use, or type a new one.
EMPLOYMENT.CONTRACT_DOCUMENT_HINT: To attach the signed contract, add it under Documents with the type "Contract" — documents also track expiry and verification.

VALIDATION.FORMAT: Check the format of this value
VALIDATION.DATE_AFTER: Must be after the start date

INVITE.TITLE: Invite employee
INVITE.NEVER_HINT: The invitation stays active until you revoke it.
INVITE.USER_NOT_FOUND: No InvoCloud user was found for this email

SCHEDULE.TITLE: Employee Schedule
SCHEDULE.CANCEL_LEAVE_SKIPPED: Nothing was cancelled — it may already have been decided.
SCHEDULE.CANCEL_TIMEOFF_CONFIRM_MSG: Every day of this leave will be cancelled, not just the one you clicked. It stays on record as cancelled.
SCHEDULE.APPROVE_CONFIRM_MSG: The employee will be shown as off for the whole period, and the days come off their balance.
SCHEDULE.REJECT_CONFIRM_MSG: The employee stays scheduled and the days are not deducted.
SCHEDULE.BULK_PARTIAL: Some entries were already decided and were left as they are.
SCHEDULE.NO_PENDING_LEAVE: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
SCHEDULE.PENDING_HR_HINT: This goes to HR for approval. It counts as time off once approved.
SCHEDULE.ADD_NOTES: Add notes about this time off…
SCHEDULE.SHIFT_INVALID_TIME: A shift's start time is on or after its end time
SCHEDULE.SHIFT_INVALID_TIME_CTX: A shift's start time is on or after its end time for {{day}} in week {{week}}
SCHEDULE.NO_EMPLOYEES_TEXT: Add employees to this branch to manage their schedules.
SCHEDULE.DELETE_SHIFT_CONFIRM_MSG: This shift will be removed from the schedule.
SCHEDULE.DELETE_TIMEOFF_CONFIRM_MSG: This time off will be removed from the schedule.
SCHEDULE.ROSTER_HINT: The team roster shows availability for bookings and is not linked to your business standard opening hours.

MY_ACCOUNT.TITLE: My Account
MY_ACCOUNT.SECURITY_DESC: Update your sign-in credentials. Turn on a toggle to change that credential — leave it off to keep the current one.
MY_ACCOUNT.PASSWORD_HINT: Password must be at least 6 characters
MY_ACCOUNT.PASSCODE_HINT: Passcode must be at least 4 digits
MY_ACCOUNT.TWO_FACTOR_HINT: Require a one-time code from your authenticator app when signing in

PAYROLL_RUN.TITLE: Payroll
PAYROLL_RUN.SUBTITLE: Work out a month's pay from punch attendance, leave and each employee's salary. Every figure can be changed.
PAYROLL_RUN.RUN_SUB: Daily rate = (basic + allowances) ÷ {{divisor}}. Type over any figure; a highlighted cell is one you changed.
PAYROLL_RUN.DIVISOR_HINT: Used to find the daily rate. 30 is usual.
PAYROLL_RUN.NO_RUNS: No payroll runs yet. Choose a month above.
PAYROLL_RUN.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete this draft payroll run? Nothing has been paid; this only removes the calculation.
PAYROLL_RUN.RECALC_HINT: Re-read attendance, leave, salaries and loans. Your changes are kept.
PAYROLL_RUN.FINALIZE_CONFIRM: Finalize this payroll run? It will be locked and can no longer be edited or recalculated.
PAYROLL_RUN.FINALIZED_NOTE: This payroll run is finalized. The figures below are locked.
PAYROLL_RUN.FLAG_NOATTENDANCE: No punches recorded — paid in full
PAYROLL_RUN.RULE_ABSENT: A working day with no punch and no approved leave is an absent day, and the daily rate is deducted for it. Rest days and public holidays are paid. Unpaid leave is deducted in calendar days.
PAYROLL_RUN.RULE_UNTRACKED: Someone with no punches at all in the month is not treated as absent — they are paid in full and flagged. Type their attendance days to change that.
PAYROLL_RUN.RULE_OVERRIDE: Typing a value replaces the calculated one and everything is recalculated from it. Clear the box (or press ×) to go back to the calculated value.
PAYROLL_RUN.RULE_STATUTORY: Social insurance and tax are not calculated here — enter them under Other deductions.

ACCESS_REQUESTS.TITLE: Access requests
ACCESS_REQUESTS.SUBTITLE: Requests from employees who were blocked from a page
ACCESS_REQUESTS.PAST_ERROR: Choose a date and time in the future.
ACCESS_REQUESTS.ARCHIVE_MSG: Archive {{count}} finished request(s)? They move to the Archived view and are kept for your records.
ACCESS_REQUESTS.ARCHIVE_SKIPPED: {{count}} selected request(s) are still pending or active and will be skipped.
ACCESS_REQUESTS.NOTHING_TO_ARCHIVE: Only dismissed, revoked or expired requests can be archived.
ACCESS_REQUESTS.NO_END_HINT: Access stays until you revoke it.
ACCESS_REQUESTS.APPLY_NOTE: Takes effect the next time the employee signs in or refreshes.
ACCESS_REQUESTS.ACTION_FAILED: Could not update the request. Please try again.

PRIVILEGES.TITLE: Privileges
PRIVILEGES.SUBTITLE: Reusable permission sets you can assign to employees
PRIVILEGES.NAME: Name
PRIVILEGES.ACCESS_HINT: Toggle the features and actions this privilege set can access
PRIVILEGES.LOCKED_HINT: This role has full access to every feature and can't be changed.
PRIVILEGES.SYSTEM_ROLE_LOCKED: This is a system role and can't be modified.
PRIVILEGES.DASHBOARD_HINT: Choose the widgets and layout employees with this privilege see on their dashboard. Save your changes here first.

ATTENDANCE.TITLE: Attendance Log
ATTENDANCE.SUBTITLE: Clock-in / clock-out records for your team
ATTENDANCE.SECTION_ORIGINAL_DESC: The clock-in / clock-out times captured by the system (read-only)
ATTENDANCE.SECTION_ADJUST_DESC: Override the recorded times if a correction is needed
ATTENDANCE.ADJ_CLOCKED_IN_HINT: Leave empty to keep the recorded clock-in time
ATTENDANCE.ADJ_CLOCKED_OUT_HINT: Leave empty to keep the recorded clock-out time
ATTENDANCE.BULK_HINT: Set clock-in and/or clock-out for all selected records. Leave a field empty to leave it unchanged.

DOCUMENTS.TITLE: Documents
DOCUMENTS.EMPTY: No documents recorded for this employee yet.
DOCUMENTS.ATTACHMENT_HINT: Optional — uploaded when you press Save.
DOCUMENTS.WARNINGS: Saved, with the following left outstanding
DOCUMENTS.EMPTY_BODY: Store contracts, IDs, and certificates for this employee.

ERR.NOT_DEPLOYED: This feature is not available on the server
ERR.NOT_DEPLOYED_HINT: The endpoint returned 404. The HR routes may not be deployed to this environment yet.
ERR.NOT_PERMITTED: You do not have permission to do that
ERR.NOT_PERMITTED_HINT: HR permissions must be granted explicitly. Check the employee's privilege set for the Documents permissions.
ERR.NO_STORAGE_HINT: The server has no document storage bucket set. Files cannot be uploaded until it is configured.
ERR.UPLOAD_REJECTED: The server did not receive the file
ERR.UPLOAD_REJECTED_HINT: The request reached the server but no file arrived with it — usually the upload middleware or the form field name rather than the file itself.
ERR.TYPE_REJECTED: That file type is not accepted

ASSETS.TITLE: Assets
ASSETS.EMPTY: Nothing has been issued to this employee.
ASSETS.NO_CATALOG: The asset catalogue could not be loaded, so the pickers are empty and the rules about return details are not applied here. Saving still works — the server will say what it does not accept.
ASSETS.TAG_HINT: Unique across the whole company — one tag, one physical item.
ASSETS.VALUE_HINT: Leave blank if not recorded. Blank is not the same as zero.
ASSETS.EMPTY_BODY: Track laptops, phones, and uniforms so they're returned at exit.

LEAVE.NO_PERIOD: The period this covers is unknown
LEAVE.NO_BALANCE: No leave balance could be loaded for this employee.
LEAVE.PENDING_COUNTS: Pending requests are already counted as used — the remaining figure reflects them, not just approved leave.
LEAVE.FALLBACK_WARNING: This employee's leave year is set to run from their hire anniversary, but no hire date is recorded. The figures below cover the calendar year instead, which is probably not the right twelve months.
LEAVE.BASIS_UNKNOWN_WARNING: The server did not say which leave year these figures cover. Treat them as indicative.
LEAVE.WARNINGS: Saved, with the following left outstanding
LEAVE.NO_SELF_APPROVAL: You cannot approve your own leave request.
LEAVE.NO_SUGGESTION: The server could not suggest a figure for these dates.
LEAVE.EXCLUDES_HOLIDAYS: Excludes rest days. Public holidays are excluded only when the chosen branch has a holiday calendar.

ENT.DAYS_BY_DOCUMENT: Days as per the supporting document
ENT.ACCRUED_NOTE: Annual leave accrues monthly: {{accrued}} accrued so far, {{available}} available to book now.
ENT.SETTINGS_INTRO: Defaults come from your country's rules and can be changed here. These are the minimums the law sets — your company may give more.
ENT.NAME: Name
ENT.RESET_CONFIRM: Discard this company's changes and go back to the country defaults?
ENT.ACCRUAL_RULES_INTRO: Annual leave set to accrue monthly is credited for each completed month (30 days → 2.5 a month). A month in which someone joins part-way earns nothing; accrual starts the next month.
ENT.UNPAID_THRESHOLD: Unpaid days that skip a month's accrual
ENT.UNPAID_THRESHOLD_HINT: If someone takes this many calendar days of unpaid leave in one month, that month earns no annual leave. 0 turns the rule off.
ENT.COMP_EXPIRY_HINT: Time off in lieu lapses this many days after it is earned. It is never added to annual leave and never paid out.
ENT.SKIP_BEFOREFIRSTFULLMONTH: no accrual — joined part-way through the month
ENT.SKIP_UNPAIDLEAVE: no accrual — unpaid leave reached the threshold
ENT.LEDGER_HINT: Every manual change is recorded with who made it and why, and can't be edited or deleted. To fix a mistake, add an opposite entry.
ENT.EARNED_ON_HINT: Defaults to today. The days expire from this date.
ENT.RATES_INTRO: Each rate is a multiple of the normal rate, as a total: 1.25 means one and a quarter times the normal pay. Starting values come from your country; leave a field empty if no rate applies.
ENT.RATE_COMP_DAY: A compensatory day off may be given instead
ENT.RATE_OVERTIMEDAYTIME_HINT: Hours over the weekly cap, worked in the daytime. Used by the attendance overtime and hours reports.
ENT.RATE_OVERTIMENIGHTTIME_HINT: Overtime worked at night. Stored for payroll; the reports do not split night hours yet.
ENT.RATE_WEEKLYRESTDAYWORKED: Worked on a weekly rest day
ENT.RATE_WEEKLYRESTDAYWORKED_HINT: Stored for payroll; the reports do not apply it yet.
ENT.RATE_PUBLICHOLIDAYWORKED_HINT: Stored for payroll; the reports do not apply it yet.

FIELD.BRANCH_HINT: Public holidays are excluded only when the chosen branch has a holiday calendar.

LEAVE.NO_PROFILE: No leave entitlement has been set for this employee, so the balance below reads zero. Set it before anyone books leave against it.
LEAVE.ENTITLEMENT_HINT: Days per leave year. This is the figure the balance is calculated from.
LEAVE.YEAR_START_HINT: Decides the twelve months the balance covers. Hire anniversary needs a hire date on the record.
LEAVE.OPENING_HINT: Migration only — the balance carried in from a previous system.
LEAVE.OPENING_LOCKED: Fixed after the first leave year closed. Changes here are ignored, because every historical balance is derived from it.
LEAVE.ACCRUAL_REASON_REQUIRED: An accrual override must record why.
LEAVE.ENTITLEMENT_NOT_CALCULATED: Encashment and air-ticket entitlement are recorded here but nothing is calculated from them — no payout value, no accrual and no next-due date. Those rules differ by country and are not implemented.
LEAVE.EXCLUDES_HOLIDAYS_BALANCE: Day counts behind these figures exclude rest days. Public holidays are excluded only for a branch that has a holiday calendar, so a request spanning one may consume fewer days than shown.
LEAVE.NO_ENTITLEMENT_ALERT: No leave entitlement is set, so the balance is zero. Set one before anyone books leave.
LEAVE.DAY_COUNT_RULES: Day counts exclude rest days. Public holidays are excluded only for a branch that has a holiday calendar, so a request spanning one may use fewer days than shown.
LEAVE.EMPTY_BODY: Requests appear here once an entitlement is set.
LEAVE.NO_ENTITLEMENT_CONFIRM: This employee has no leave entitlement, so the request cannot be checked against a balance. Request leave anyway?

PERFORMANCE.NO_CATALOG: The performance catalogue could not be loaded. Statuses and ratings will be blank, and the rules about who may write what are not applied here — the server still enforces them.
PERFORMANCE.OVERRIDDEN: This score was overridden by hand
PERFORMANCE.NO_REASON: No reason was recorded for the override.
PERFORMANCE.CALIBRATION_NOTE: The computed score is kept as it is. This records an override alongside it.

TRAINING.NAME: Course
TRAINING.EXPIRY_HINT: Feeds the reminder engine. No expiry status is computed for trainings, so only the date is shown.

PERFORMANCE.EMPTY_REVIEWS_BODY: Record reviews to build a performance history.
PERFORMANCE.EMPTY_TRAININGS_BODY: Log courses and certifications as they're completed.

DISCIPLINARY.TITLE: Disciplinary Records
DISCIPLINARY.SUBJECT_NOTE: These are the records held about you. You can read them, add your own statement while the response period is open, and appeal.
DISCIPLINARY.ESCALATION_NOTE: Spent warnings — expired or overturned on appeal — stay on the record but are excluded from this figure.
DISCIPLINARY.LEVEL_UNKNOWN: The escalation position could not be determined.
DISCIPLINARY.WITNESS_NOTE: A refusal to sign must name a witness. Enter it now — it cannot be added convincingly later.
DISCIPLINARY.STATEMENT_NOTE: This is your own statement. It can be changed until the response period closes, after which it is fixed. Deadline:
DISCIPLINARY.WINDOW_CLOSED: The response period has closed, so the statement can no longer be changed. Deadline was
DISCIPLINARY.NO_SELF_APPEAL: You issued this warning, so you cannot decide the appeal against it.

FIELD.EXPIRY_HINT: After this date the warning is spent and no longer counts towards escalation. Leave blank if it never lapses.
FIELD.DEADLINE_HINT: Until this date the employee may write their own statement. Leave blank to give no response period.

DISCIPLINARY.NO_LIVE_WARNINGS_NOTE: No live warnings. Expired or overturned warnings stay on record but don't count here.

PAYROLL.SUBJECT_NOTE: This is your own pay record. You can see it but not change it — pay and bank changes are made by payroll.
PAYROLL.NOTHING_VISIBLE: You do not have permission to see pay or bank details for this employee.
PAYROLL.NO_PAY: No pay record for this employee.
PAYROLL.CHANGE_NOTE: This records a new pay row effective from the date you choose. The existing figures are kept — nothing is overwritten, so past payslips stay answerable.
PAYROLL.NOT_TAKE_HOME: This is not take-home pay. Social insurance, gratuity and end-of-service are not calculated by this system, so nothing for them has been deducted here.
PAYROLL.EFFECTIVE_HINT: A future date schedules the change; it will not apply until then.
PAYROLL.HISTORY_NOTE: Every change is a new row. Correcting a figure means recording another change, not editing this one.
PAYROLL.REPAID_HINT: The balance is worked out from what has actually been repaid, not from how much time has passed.
PAYROLL.IBAN_INVALID: That IBAN does not pass its check digits. Check for a transposed or missing character.
PAYROLL.AUDIT_NOTE: The audit trail will record this change as:
PAYROLL.SPLIT_IBAN_INVALID: Check the IBAN on split account
PAYROLL.TAX_NOT_CALCULATED: Tax information is recorded here only. No tax is calculated or deducted from any figure on this page.
PAYROLL.NO_PAY_ALERT: No pay record yet. Payroll can't run for this employee until one is set up.

BENEFITS.HOUSING_BLOCKED: This employee receives a housing allowance in payroll, so company housing cannot also be provided.
BENEFITS.HOUSING_CONFLICT: This record has both company housing and a housing allowance in payroll. Only one should apply — correct whichever is wrong.
BENEFITS.VEHICLE_HINT: Vehicles are recorded as assets, so they are returned and cleared with everything else.

FILES.NO_DOCUMENTS_YET: No documents yet. Add one on the Documents tab, then attach files to it here.
FILES.SAVE_EMPLOYEE_FIRST: Save the employee first — there is no record to attach files to yet.
FILES.NO_UPLOAD_PERMISSION: You do not have permission to attach files to this employee.
FILES.STORAGE_UNCONFIGURED: Document storage is not configured on this server.

HOLIDAYS.TITLE: Holiday calendars
HOLIDAYS.NAME: Calendar name
HOLIDAYS.NO_DAYS: No days in this calendar yet.
HOLIDAYS.DUPLICATE_DATES: The same date appears more than once
HOLIDAYS.UNAVAILABLE: This server does not offer holiday calendars yet. Nothing is missing from your data — the feature is not deployed here.
HOLIDAYS.SCOPE_NOTE: Calendars are managed here only. Leave day counts already recorded are unchanged, and whether the leave suggestion excludes public holidays is decided by the server.

EOS.BLOCKED_OPEN_ASSETS: Company property is still assigned to this employee
EOS.NEEDS_REHIRE_REASON: Marking someone as not eligible for rehire needs a reason
EOS.NEEDS_OVERRIDE_REASON: An overridden settlement line needs a reason
EOS.NOT_CALCULATED: Settlement isn't calculated. Enter gratuity, leave encashment, and notice pay manually.
EOS.TOTAL_PENDING: Not yet — a line is undecided
EOS.IS_COMPLETED: This record is completed. The termination date has been set and access revoked for this company.
EOS.eos.blockedOpenAssets: Company property is still assigned to this employee
EOS.eos.needsRehireReason: Marking someone as not eligible for rehire needs a reason
EOS.eos.needsOverrideReason: An overridden settlement line needs a reason
EOS.DATE_ORDER_ERROR: Last working day must be on or after the notice date
EOS.BLOCKING_REASON_REQUIRED: Blocking reason is required when blocked
EOS.LOCK_NOTE: Finalizing unlocks when all departments clear.
EOS.FINALIZE_CONFIRM: This ends the employee's employment, sets their termination date and revokes their access. It can't be undone.

GOSI.TITLE: GOSI settings
GOSI.SUBTITLE: Bahrain social-insurance contribution rates and the Tier 3 end-of-service gratuity policy.
GOSI.NOT_A_CALCULATOR: This page configures the rates. Payroll does not yet calculate GOSI deductions automatically.
GOSI.NO_PERMISSION: You do not have permission to view GOSI settings.

RATES.TITLE: Contribution rates
RATES.SUBTITLE: One row per effective period. A changed rate is always a new period — existing rows are never edited in place.
RATES.ESCALATION_HINT: Auto-escalation lets the rate climb automatically each year without a new row. Leave blank if this rate is flat and does not change automatically.
RATES.ESCALATES_HINT: This rate auto-escalates — see the increment and end year on the add-period form.
RATES.REVIEW_INTERVAL_HINT: The real rates aren't known yet, so instead of guessing an annual increase, set a reminder to come back and check the official source.
RATES.SOURCE_HINT: Required — documents where the rate figures came from, since the source cannot be verified automatically.

TIER3.TITLE: Tier 3 — non-GCC expatriate gratuity policy
TIER3.SUBTITLE: Whether the state contribution replaces the end-of-service gratuity for non-GCC expatriate employees.
TIER3.DECISION_HINT: Not yet decided is a real, separate state — it is not the same as choosing No.
TIER3.DECISION_YES: Yes — the state contribution replaces gratuity
TIER3.DECISION_NO: No — gratuity is still owed separately
TIER3.DECISION_REQUIRED: Choose Yes or No before saving — leave it as "Not yet decided" if there is nothing to save yet

WIZARD.PAYMENT_QUESTION: How would you like to pay this employee?
WIZARD.METHOD_NEEDS_PAY: The payment method is recorded with the employee's pay. Set their salary on the Payroll tab first, then choose how they are paid.
WIZARD.METHOD_CHANGE_NOTE: Payment method changed. Pay figures unchanged.

SALES_SUMMARY.EMPTY: No sales recorded for this employee in this period.
SALES_SUMMARY.TITLE: Sales performance

ATTENDANCE_SUMMARY.EMPTY: No attendance recorded in this period.
ATTENDANCE_SUMMARY.TITLE: Attendance
ATTENDANCE_SUMMARY.STRIP: Daily attendance for the last 30 days

OVERVIEW.SECTION_EMPTY: Not recorded yet - use the pencil to add it
